description: Japanese input helper for Windows that types Japanese and English without toggling the input mode
notes: Meltype works right away with the conversion box (candidates under the cursor). IME mode (typing straight into the text field) is optional. To register it once, open an elevated PowerShell (Run as administrator) and run:
After that, press Win + Space and pick 'Meltype'. Skip this if the conversion box is fine.
Don't run the bundled Install.cmd: it installs a second copy under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Meltype that Scoop doesn't manage.
Start at sign-in from the tray menu ('Windows の起動時に起動'); if Meltype stops starting after an update, toggle that item off and on again.

Update: quit Meltype (tray > Exit), then 'scoop update meltype'. Meltype cannot update itself, but your settings, learning data and the IME registration are kept (if IME mode stops working after an update, run the two lines above again).
Uninstall: 'scoop uninstall meltype' also deletes %LOCALAPPDATA%\Meltype and unregisters the IME, so back that folder up first.
pre_uninstall: Get-Process Meltype, meltype_mozc_helper, AutoIME -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($isUpdate) { Write-Host 'Updating Meltype: keeping the IME registration and the user data.'; return }

if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ime) { . $ime; if (-not (Uninstall-MeltypeIme)) { Write-Host 'Meltype IME is still registered. Run C:\Program Files\Meltype\tip\Register-Tip.ps1 -Unregister as administrator.' } }

foreach ($name in 'Meltype', 'AutoIME') { $data = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA $name; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $data) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $data -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $leftover) { Write-Host "Could not remove $leftover. Delete it as administrator." }
$separate = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\Meltype'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $separate) { Write-Host "A Meltype copy installed outside Scoop is left in place: $separate" }
